title: Pre-OCV Meeting with Assistant Governor (AG)
summary: The Rotary Club of Chembur Mumbai conducted a Pre-Official Club Visit (Pre-OCV) meeting with the Assistant Governor (AG) on Monday, 2nd November 2026, at 6:30 PM at RCF Officers Club, RCF Colony, Chembur, Mumbai – 400074.
description:
The Rotary Club of Chembur Mumbai conducted a Pre-Official Club Visit (Pre-OCV) meeting with the Assistant Governor (AG) on Monday, 2nd November 2026, at 6:30 PM at RCF Officers Club, RCF Colony, Chembur, Mumbai – 400074.

The meeting focused on reviewing the club's activities, ongoing and completed service projects, achievements, documentation and preparations for the upcoming Official Club Visit (OCV). Discussions were also held on club performance, Rotary goals and ensuring proper documentation and readiness for the official visit.

Meeting Details:
- Date: 2nd November 2026 (Monday)
- Time: 6:30 PM
- Venue: RCF Officers Club, RCF Colony, Chembur, Mumbai – 400074
